comparison: Proof bodies, definitions used, actual theorem dependencies, local premises and dependent-type or carrier conditions.

findings: The declared order is local input, indexed role family, then carrier realization. The native family construction depends on supplied binding data and not a realization. The introductory four-field audit remains a methodological specification.

The four functional fields are not identified with the four Role constructors. The former is a reporting/achievement specification; the latter is the later typed local construction. Native role-case results supply no theorem classifying all physics.

Representation name plus the four functional fields plus prior-use dependencies yields the six reporting fields. This is not a new six-role or six-failure-series theorem; the supporting role proof has no such extra conclusion.
The adopted four-field/six-record form is applied to the stated descriptions. Its application does not assert that each example has already met the generation conditions.

Primitive-time exclusion is the source input boundary. Counter update and typed family construction have no duration/frequency premise, but their abstract data types are not treated as a proof of physical purity of arbitrary payloads.
BindWitness supplies all four condition proofs in one scene. The native preservation theorem projects supplied components; it does not derive the binding predicates from an arbitrary quadruple.
The same scene-indexed LC and binding witness feed the four projections. The source assigns time quantities to later output; neither native preservation proof moves them into the input.

Both backends use natural counters, successor update and arbitrary phase/display functions. Counter injectivity uses successor cancellation. Repeated-display control retains the counter coordinate. No equal-duration, periodicity or calibrated-unit premise was added.
The native repeated-display witness and successor proof support internal repetition without equal temporal intervals. Later generated quantities are not conclusions of these five counter roots.

Finite or locally bounded and the four physical membership criteria remain source-domain requirements. Lean Scene/LC and HOL local_carrier preserve a supplied scene; neither is credited with deriving physical locality from an abstract type.
The C/D/B/O tags specify role positions. Datatype case distinctions do not require four distinct physical objects or components.

Base roles are C/D/B/O. The later source subset C/D/B and comparison subset C/D remain distinct from the realization subset C/D/O. Native exhaustiveness/injectivity proofs preserve these different exclusions.

The arbitrary role-indexed component product precedes the binding subset. Lean scene/role-dependent carriers correspond to guarded HOL local-carrier sets. Empty products are not excluded and binding conditions are not imposed on every arbitrary tuple.

All four binding conditions retain the same scene and same components. Clock/body/detector argument order in the first two predicates is their signature, not a change to the stored C/D/B/O tuple. HOL valid_carrier_input and its actual_binding_and_scene_preserved helper expose the matching conjunction.

The initials name the same four roles and the caption uses the same binding construction. The imported figure adds no independent logical obligation. Role, operational component and physical carrier remain separate types.
Each index determines one object, scene and binding witness. No injectivity of the assignment or uniqueness of all possible physical witnesses is assumed.

Equality projects the stored index; the converse substitutes into the same assignment. Scene/role membership is carried by Lean dependent types and by HOL valid-input guards. Coincident physical data do not merge distinct indices.

Lean selected-index subtype and HOL restricted function graph both retain exactly Z0. The realization domain is the image of C/D/O components and excludes B. The abstraction source is a supplied proof field/conjunct, not a realization of B.

roleInstance/roleAt and bodyPair depend only on specified input. The native independence proof unfolds assemble and leaves its body component unchanged under two realizations. No existence of a physical realization is inferred.

The proof sequence constructs the indexed four-role bundle, restricts to Z0 and retains the abstraction source before any realization parameter. The realized extension preserves the existing base by projection; no chronological premise occurs.

The synopsis uses the same input boundary, witness, indexed bundle, B abstraction and C/D/O realization domain. Its references introduce no new assumptions beyond those reviewed for the underlying definitions and synthesis.

The position conclusion is eight projection equalities. Abstraction uses ObjectSpecData.bodyAbstractedFrom / valid_carrier_input. Realization exclusion uses the non-Body role subtype / three-constructor role. The source nonprimitive-input conclusion follows its defined input boundary, not arbitrary uninterpreted data.

The native synthesis invokes family-position preservation, the supplied abstraction-source witness and realization-role exclusion. Each dependency matches the corresponding source definition. The identical-data/different-index control is a control only, not a specialization replacing the general theorem.

The C/D/B/O role bundle remains indexed by object-specification position; realizing C/D/O does not turn B into a fourth realization-map argument. The reused Chapter 2 dependencies preserve this separation.
Source roles are exactly C/D/B and comparison roles exactly C/D. Constructor exclusion and injectivity do not remove the B arrival/recovery family or admit O as a source role.

Physical C/D/O carrier families, communication carriers and the indexed B abstraction-source correspondence have distinct types. Body tokens retain the tracked-object component. Distributed observation requires a communication witness, not just distinct observers.

Realization is evaluated on the selected role-instance image; B is the existing indexed abstraction-source pair. Total HOL functions are used only on that image. Values outside it do not become source-domain inputs or physical existence claims.

Two instances with different object-specification indices remain different even when realization values coincide. Native index projection/injectivity proofs do not infer distinct physical carriers from distinct roles.

Shared/separated are equality/inequality within the same carrier role. Observer-distributed additionally includes existence of a coupling carrier. Tagged HOL sums preserve the within-role tests through comparison_inl/comparison_inr.

The caption applies the role-versus-carrier distinction already defined in the text. The figure supplies no separate premise or theorem. Coincident physical realization leaves the two indexed roles distinct.
All four table rows preserve their exact conditions: C/D equality or inequality, O equality, and O inequality plus communication. Both language versions retain the conjunction in the distributed row.

The theorem assembles supplied carrier values and supplied choice/coupling conditions at two distinct indices. It does not prove arbitrary physical realizability of every combination. Lean Fin 2 and HOL False/True enumerate the same two positions.

Native dependencies are value substitution, sum-injection equality preservation, assembly projections and body-pair index distinction. No independence or existence assumption beyond the stated supplied realization conditions was added to terminate proof search.
Membership in the role-instance image retains the role tag and the selected index. Physical realization is subsequent data and does not replace membership in the abstract family.
Index identity and component/physical identity are separate tests. Native role-instance injectivity applies to the same specified assignment and retains distinct positions even for identical data.
The four-party local construction does not require four distinct carriers. The three realization roles and B abstraction correspondence retain their separate responsibilities under sharing.

The input formation supplies physical realization and reception data before comparison. This is an input-domain obligation; native tuple preservation is not credited as proof that arbitrary abstract payloads are physically non-temporal.

Both languages declare first-use full role/phase subscripts and permit only uniquely recoverable omission of a fixed phase within the same block. Arrival/recovery short forms retain role indices and do not merge different phases.

The reception network has a nonempty phase family, receivers in the O realization image, and a supplied partial order on the tagged C/D/B reception union. Empty individual fibers remain allowed; no global order between phases is supplied.

The raw bundle retains the selected role family, carrier realization, B correspondence and reception network. Lean dependent fields correspond to HOL valid_raw guards, including realized-receiver membership and the supplied reception order.

Clock-source indices are nonempty and label physical sources supported by C carriers. Support selection chooses an existing witness and is not injective: different sources may share a carrier. No timing period or calibrated unit is introduced.

Each source uses the Chapter 2 natural counter and successor update with arbitrary display. Native counter proofs retain repeated displays and do not infer equal temporal duration of successive updates.
The tagged Source × Nat encoding preserves the unique source/counter pair and hence the source-index projection. Within-source counter identity and cross-source tag distinction are both retained.

Within a fixed source the relation is exactly natural-number non-strict order. The fixed-source correspondence lemma connects this relation to the tagged-family relation without introducing comparisons across tags.
Reflexivity, transitivity and antisymmetry follow from natural order and the unique counter representation. The formal result is universal in the source, not a two-source test example.

The source proof transports all three partial-order laws through token identity. The native proof uses the same natural-order laws; no time coordinate, total external order or counter-rate premise enters.

The display map is arbitrary and equality of displays does not identify distinct source/counter pairs. The constant-display positive control illustrates the general theorem; it does not replace that theorem. Physical time exclusion remains the input specification.

Token identity is determined jointly by record content and natural record index. The native RecordIdentity/record_identity predicate is exactly injectivity of that pair, not injectivity of the index alone. The exact-source bridge retains this source condition.

The relation is token equality OR strict inequality of indices. It is not non-strict index comparison, which would incorrectly compare distinct equal-index records. The content embedding transports the same relation under the pair-identity condition.
Partial-order laws require no injectivity of the index: equality branches substitute, strict branches use natural-order transitivity/asymmetry. Both native proofs preserve that stronger generality.

Native dependence on detector_le/DLE and natural strict-order laws matches the source equality/strict-order case split. Antisymmetry does not assume the desired token equality or a globally linear record order.

The two hypotheses are distinct tokens and equal indices; both directions of incomparability are conclusions. Neither backend drops one direction or silently strengthens equal indices to equal tokens.

Each assumed comparison contradicts the equal-index hypothesis after exclusion of token equality. The Bool same-index control is supplementary; the root theorem still quantifies over arbitrary content types.

Finite, self-containing cells and the membership/equal-cell equivalence remain supplied record-data conditions. Configuration preservation projects all three, and their partition consequence does not require a finite aggregate token set.

The nonempty B-token carrier maps to selected object positions and retains the tracked-object abstraction-source pair. Multiple tokens at the same position are allowed; no injectivity of bodyPosition is introduced.

The aggregate relation conjoins source-tag equality with the within-source order. The encoding as tag equality and natural ≤ is exact through the fixed-source correspondence, not a lexicographic order.
The three laws hold on the whole tagged union. Equality of tags keeps transitive comparisons in one component; antisymmetry uses both tag and counter equality.
Both native proofs implement the source component argument. No choice of a preferred source or external cross-source order is a dependency.
Unequal source indices rule out both directions of the family order even if counters or displays agree. The statement is universal and not restricted to the Bool positive control.
Both directions reduce to the required tag equality. Native product equality and family_le/CFamilyLE are sufficient; a temporal comparison premise is absent.

Arrival is partial with explicit source domain and may identify distinct tokens. Lean domain subtypes correspond to HOL domain guards. The empty-domain control is allowed; no global injectivity or surjectivity is assumed.
Specializing the same source-role family to B retains the same phase and explicit arrival domain. B is not omitted by the C/D-only comparison relation.

Recovery is defined only for a nonempty singleton arrival fiber. Lean choose and HOL THE select that unique token; recover_eq_original preserves source indices and B positions by substitution. No value outside the recoverable domain is assigned source meaning.
The relation is on C/D receptions at one common phase. Both role tags and that phase are retained; no B/O coordinate or cross-phase comparison is added.

The biconditional is a supplied compatibility condition for source pairs in both arrival domains at the same phase. The native preservation proof projects it and does not claim to derive arbitrary relation compatibility.

The bundle retains C/D/B token families, displays, joint record identity, B positions, cells, derived source orders, arrivals, derived recoveries and compatible C/D relations. ExactSourceData supplies the record-identity condition already present in the source.

The configuration is the raw/source-data ordered pair with dependent typing/validity, not two unrelated records. Pairing and roundtrip preserve both components; exact-source pairing also retains record identity.
The entire realized configuration supplies the comparison-stage domain. This boundary does not collapse raw physical evidence into the later time representation.

All listed typed components survive pairing. Native roots separately preserve role/index positions, realized receivers, source orders, cells, recovery and relation compatibility. Non-temporal physical-input qualification is the source-domain requirement, not a new theorem about arbitrary payload types.

The native chain projects the raw and exact-source components and uses the proved recovery identity. SourceData.relationCompatibility and cell laws are supplied obligations, not inferred physical facts. No conclusion is credited merely because a product can be formed.

The synopsis couples the same physical realization and reception network, then retains the same source data. C/D comparison, C/D/B sources and C/D/O realization remain separate throughout the dependencies.

The six-field material package and typed rule input precede stage success. Source relations and comparison-source relations remain separate; shortening a fixed node index does not remove a role or varying index.

Common evaluation is uncurrying. The configuration adapter preserves arrivals and both relation fields by definitional equality. The residual-stage entry theorem retains L1 and L2 before invoking the already reviewed construction.
Lean stores variable reception carriers in dependent types; HOL empties DC/DD outside reception_nodes. Recovery is used only on recoverable values, not as a pre-entry total inverse.
The caption summarizes the body construction from comparison-rule-dependent common input, through the seven conditions and G, to the quotient output. It adds no figure-only theorem.

The caption is traced through the same raw-entry and stage-generation roots as the notation prelude; generated_valid uses realizability, output_unique uses loop realization uniqueness and least image containment, and injectivity separately uses mixed and pure loop identity.
No output-generation theorem is interpreted as proving its own input conditions. Figure layout and content are unchanged.

Common evaluation preserves the ordered pair of realized configuration and typed rule family. The integration adapter retains arrival and relation fields when later stage conditions hold; those conditions are not required to package the raw common input. No time-coordinate input or success assertion is added.

The six material fields remain the reception network, role-indexed source family, comparison arrivals, domain-restricted recovery, the ordered pair of local/source relations, and the supplied comparison rules. The fifth field is not flattened and the rules are not replaced by generated transport or realized actions. Later L1/L2 adapter parameters are not premises of this packaging definition.
Adm is an arbitrary subset of ordered reception-node pairs. The joint relation has exactly the two actual-image products as its source and target; the four role coordinates keep their order.

PairDatum has no L1/L2 premise. pairEncoding is an explicit equivalence with inverse. extend/restrict round trips hold on the carriers; restriction_identity_iff shows that an ambient relation is unchanged exactly when it is carrier-typed.
The exact HOL seed supplies joint_carrier, while the general seed alone is not used as the paper input. No symmetry, totality, or componentwise factorization is inferred from the definition.

The raw specification precedes L1/L2 and retains positive length, m+1 positions, m traversal signs, equal endpoints, and the direction-dependent admission test. The selected family is an arbitrary subset, and specified domains may be empty. Exact display reconstruction and tagged_domain_exact preserve the source tuple; native_spec_positive separately bridges the later action construction.

Unique recovery is quantified over the actual arrival image at every phase, for each comparison role. Native l1_iff_injective uses domain-restricted injectivity, including empty domains. Its negation yields two distinct in-domain tokens with one arrival, without presupposing successful L1 or transport realization.

The equivalence, recovery-domain membership, and both inverse equations are retained. Lean domain subtypes and recover_eq_original correspond to HOL recovery_domain/recover_arrival; arrival_recovery supplies the other direction. The source L1 hypothesis suffices for all these facts.

The actual native chain uses singleton fibers, the chosen in-domain preimage and uniqueness. HOL inv_into and THE representations agree on the unique fiber; neither total extension is given meaning outside the source domain/image. No inverse identity is assumed to prove itself.

Source indices 1 through 7 correspond to native indices 0 through 6. The first receives only the configuration; the other six receive its pair with the rule family. The sum-tag dispatch preserves that distinction, and the first completion bundle is exactly its first condition. Residual unguarded consequents are not substituted for the source conditional predicates.

The sourcePartial domain is exactly the first arrival image restricted by membership of its recovered source in the second arrival domain. The graph bridge retains that full domain and the second arrival value. All ordered phase pairs are allowed independently of transport admissibility.

Recovery preservation implies exact inverse-graph equality. source_reverse and reverse_domain_is_image give image/domain equality; inverse_composition_on_domain gives the identity on precisely the forward domain. The source-match injectivity theorem discharges the graph-injection condition, rather than adding it as a physical premise.

The native proof follows the same recovered source through both arrivals, then exchanges the arbitrary phases. HOL source_family.injective is discharged by L1 equivalence, matching Lean h:L1. Graph functional/injective proofs cover both directions and domain equality, not only common-domain pointwise equality.

The dependent-role factorization retains the joint domain and each injection on its exact role projection. domain_forced and component_graph_exact recover them from the prescribed joint graph without enlarging the domain to a Cartesian product. HOL normalizes only off-domain function extensions; the coupled counterexample confirms that a joint function alone does not imply component factorization.

Both native L2 definitions retain the L1 implication. Existence is equivalent to unique existence because factorization_unique already proves uniqueness on exact projected domains; no separate component-injectivity assumption is imposed before factorization. Under L1 and L2, joint_graph_exact and transport_partial_injection recover the complete selected datum. The old ledger sentence calling its HOL adapter pending is a metadata status defect, not the status of the verified native theorem.

The native transport family is indexed by exactly the admitted position pairs and retains the same prescribed joint relation under L1 and L2. joint_graph_exact identifies its joint domain and component values, while transport_preserved carries them into the later input. The frozen ledger pending-status sentence is stale; both corresponding HOL native facts are present and checked.

The carrier constructor is the dependent tagged union of actual arrival images, without an L1 or nonemptiness premise. HOL tagged regions restrict the ambient values to those images. Removing a redundant outer copy of the same tag preserves the position, so equal arrival values at distinct positions remain distinct.

PartialInjection supplies its exact domain, value and injectivity. imageEquiv has exactly the image as codomain; tagging changes the position tag and retains the value. HOL singleton-tag carriers and inj_on f A encode the same restriction, including an empty A.

The inverse is on the tagged image, not the entire ambient target. HOL inverse_graph_exact matches equality of Lean subtype equivalences. Both left and right identity clauses are present; no nonempty-domain premise is required.

The checked dependencies reduce the inverse value to the reversed tag and the inverse of the same supplied injection. Exact image equality supplies its domain; the two native inverse identities discharge both compositions.

After the source L1/L2 and admissible-pair conditions supply the transport injection, the same tag-lift construction defines the forward term and its image inverse. The algebraic component does not prove transport existence or introduce an independent reverse transport edge.

Both sign choices are the left/right inverse identities of the one forward transport term. The original ordered-pair identifier is retained for its formal inverse; a reverse edge with separately supplied physical data is not substituted.

The proof specializes partialLift_both_identities to the already supplied admissible transport. There is no additional totality assumption, no enlarged domain and no new physical premise in either dependency chain.

TagLift is applied to the source-matching partial injection already justified under L1. Unlike transport terms, all ordered phase pairs are allowed; neither L2 nor transport-pair admissibility enters this definition.

source_term_inverse gives exact reversed graph equality; source_term_domain identifies the recovered-source domain; source_term_composition_identity gives the identity on that domain. Exchanging arbitrary phase indices supplies the other direction without identifying equal values across tags.

The native proof combines source_reverse with tagged_graph_reverse, then applies the inverse-composition graph law. Source injectivity is derived from L1 and retained by tagging; it is not assumed as a second unexplained physical condition.

CorePartialMapBridge covers the opening arbitrary-partial-map composition without an injectivity field. Its domain/value graph is exact. The subsequent sequence uses partial injections with all intermediate types retained. Empty action is identity on the starting carrier and recursion gives the maximal domain, not a chosen smaller domain.

The native convention Graph.comp f g is g after f, matching the source order. Concatenation preserves exact domain and value; reversing the list and each atom gives the inverse graph. Partial injectivity is derived from functionality of forward/reversed actions, with zero-length sequences included.

The dependency chain reaches typed-word append/reverse induction and graph extensionality. HOL typed lists and Lean endpoint-indexed words keep the same intermediate carriers. General composition is not restricted to injections; injection is used only for the declared injection sequence.

The admitted endpoint/kind triples are encoded as endpoint-indexed subtypes in Lean and an explicitly guarded relation in HOL. Dagger involution and reverse-graph equality are supplied atomic-system conditions. Forward and reverse functionality derive partial injectivity; no carrier-disjointness or extra endpoint premise is added.

Raw words retain the initial position and all edge kinds/terminal positions. The encode/decode bijection, tuple lengths and tuple reconstruction cover the general admitted alphabet, not only three concrete kinds. Both systems preserve empty words, concatenation, reverse words and the existential intermediate-value action domain.

The source identities, exact concatenation domain/value, inverse action and domain/image clauses follow from the generic typed-word action. Domain, range, support and loop-family definitions retain their endpoint indices. No total action or arbitrary disjoint carrier assumption replaces a partial one.

Empty/append/reverse induction and functionality of forward and reversed actions supply the checked conclusions. The raw-word encoding lemmas transfer these facts while preserving each displayed tuple and its action, rather than proving only an endpoint-erased specialization.

The raw-union relation existentially forgets both endpoint tags, as expressed by erased_orbit_word_witness. This definition alone does not assert transitivity when carriers overlap. The separate tagged relation therefore is not silently substituted for the source relation.

Lean disjoint_union_tag_bridge and erased_orbit_exact_if_disjoint transport tagged equivalence to the raw union; HOL orbit_equivalence retains the same disjointness condition. Tags discharge the condition only for an explicitly tagged instance.

Reflexivity uses the endpoint-specific empty word; symmetry uses reverse action. Transitivity identifies the common intermediate endpoint by the stated carrier-disjointness assumption and then concatenates words. Both native chains preserve this premise and all three equivalence clauses.

Saturated and saturated_on retain membership equivalence along the supplied relation on the specified carrier. An arbitrary subset is not silently treated as saturated; HOL explicitly bounds both endpoints by the carrier.

The equality-kernel hypothesis and saturation imply the exact image pullback. image_least and image_unique_least cover containment and uniqueness of the least image-containing subset. Neither native statement requires surjectivity onto the ambient target.

The proof extracts an image witness, applies the equality-kernel implication, and transfers membership by saturation. Leastness uses an arbitrary containing set and uniqueness uses mutual inclusion; the native dependency chain does not replace the target by the image to manufacture surjectivity.

The exact fixed-set/domain equality is preserved. Its pointwise form is proved using functionality, which is already part of being a partial map. Empty domains satisfy the same definition; totality and domain nonemptiness are not added.

The source quotient is the range of the class-valued projection in both encodings. Lean class_native_bijective and class_native_commutes explicitly identify it with the native Quotient. HOL class_quotient agrees with the set quotient, with every claim restricted to its actual carrier.

Surjectivity is onto the set of equivalence classes and the equality kernel is precisely the given equivalence relation. Empty carriers remain permitted. A chosen representative is used only for an existing class in the separate native-quotient bridge.

The native proof obtains a representative from range membership for surjectivity. Reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity and set extensionality give the two directions of the class-equality criterion. The source does not need a global representative selection.

loop_identity_exact identifies pointwise LoopIdentity with fixed-set/domain equality for every closed word. The quantifier includes empty words and words with empty action domains. No disjointness premise is introduced at the predicate-definition stage.

Both directions concern the actual word-orbit quotient and the restriction to each carrier. The Lean tagged quotient is connected to the raw union by the disjoint-tag bijection and exact erased-orbit relation; HOL proves the carrier-restricted criterion under that same disjointness premise.

Forward reasoning obtains a word from equal quotient classes and uses disjointness to make its endpoints the same local carrier. Reverse reasoning sends a closed-word action to equal quotient classes and applies local injectivity. The conclusion is identity only on the actual partial domain.

The selected atom subtype retains original admissibility and imposes exactly membership in the inverse-stable kind subset. Restricted actions are unchanged. The inherited inverse, involution, functionality and reverse graph law follow from the original system; no new transport or nonempty-kind condition is assumed.

L1 supplies source functionality and L2 factorization supplies component injections; the generic system obligations are proved from these, not added. The fixed-phase arrival abbreviation retains its u index under the stated convention.

The native carrier is the dependent sum of actual arrival-image fibers. Its index regions cover the whole carrier and distinct tags have empty intersection. The proof works already at the tagged-carrier level, so retaining the source L-le2 context adds no unsupported conclusion.

Coverage takes the point's existing tag; disjointness derives equality of two tags from membership in both regions. HOL native_region/native_carrier and Lean Sigma regions encode the same argument without identifying equal arrival values at distinct positions.

The sign-to-kind encoding is used only on the transport-only family, retaining both orientations and excluding src. The raw/native encoding is bijective and transport_kinds_recovered gives its sign round trip. Display shapes retain m+1 positions and m signs, including m=0.

Transport-only words are closed under concatenation and reversal. The embeddings preserve empty words, append and reverse. Lean append p q traverses p first, matching the source w1-star-w0 order; HOL list append uses that same traversal.

The checked four-part theorem includes reverse action, exact append domain, composite graph and empty identity. Its endpoint types and transport-only hypotheses are retained. No closed-loop identity or nonempty-word premise is used.

Both dependencies specialize the already checked abstract append, reverse and domain laws, with closure of the pure family. The displayed/native bridge preserves the complete graph, so this is an application of the source generic lemma rather than an independent weaker action model.

native_partial_injectivity supplies functionality and injectivity of each action graph. Specialization to the transport-only family preserves both clauses without claiming totality or a nonempty action domain.

The actual proof uses generic action_functional and action_injective; action_preservation transfers them to the displayed transport word. It does not assume the transport-word conclusion to establish its atomic prerequisites.

The family is transport-only words with equal endpoint indices, including empty words. Native path typing and injective display reconstruction preserve the entire position/sign sequence. Neither loop identity nor later mixed-loop conditions are prerequisites of this family definition.

The omitted kind list is recovered as m copies of src. source_positions_suffice and source_display_injective retain all intermediate positions, and unique_pure_preimages identifies the source-only subtype. Source admissibility remains unrestricted by transport-admissible pairs.

Restriction to src evaluates only source arrival/recovery at every step. The graph and domain equal their displayed counterparts. The surrounding comparison datum is inherited context, not a premise asserting any transport action is actually used.

Source-only closure preserves the constant kind list under append and reversal, while reversing endpoint order. The empty source word has the same extended empty image as the empty transport word without identifying their nonempty families.

source_action_laws retains all four abstract conclusions for the source-only subtype, including exact concatenation domains. No source-loop identity is assumed as a prerequisite; that identity is derived separately afterward.

The checked source_action_laws dependencies are precisely abstract append_action, append_domain and reverse_action plus the empty action. Display preservation transfers the restricted action without changing the carriers or admissibility.

The existing unlabelled source lemma is mapped by its blk ID to both graph functionality and injectivity. The comparison system supplies source inverses through recovery, and the displayed action has the same full graph.

Native generic action functionality and reverse-based injectivity justify this specific unlabelled lemma. Its proof is kept distinct from the preceding action-law proof; no source-map totality is inferred.

source_path_preserves_recovery propagates the same recovered source along the whole source-only path. Equal start/end positions then give equal arrivals, so the action is identity on its exact domain rather than on the full local carrier.

Lean induction uses srcGraph_iff_same_recovery and recovery_injective; HOL uses source_sequence_recovery and arrival_recovery on actual images. Neither native chain assumes the desired closed-loop identity or uses a transport-loop condition.

The raw/native bijection preserves the complete three-kind display, every intermediate endpoint and the length relation. Extended words retain mixed sequences and the empty sequence; they are not reduced to a pure subfamily.

The extended action evaluates the original three atom cases with their exact domain restrictions. Encoding preserves the full graph and its existential domain, including source and both signed transport steps.

The generic empty, append and reverse constructors apply directly to the native comparison system. The source star order is translated as first-word then second-word append; reversal reverses both order and each atomic orientation.

extended_action_laws has the full four-part conclusion on arbitrary admitted comparison words. Its comparison system is constructed from the actual arrival/recovery and transport data; no pure-word hypothesis restricts this result.

Both native proofs apply the generic typed-action laws to the constructed comparison system. The same displayed/native bridge preserves domains and values; mixed words require no new independent action axiom.
The blk ID selects the extended-word partial-injectivity lemma, with its graph functionality and injectivity clauses. Arbitrary extended paths, including mixed and empty words, are retained.

action_functional and action_injective are specialized to the extended comparison path and transferred through exact action preservation. This proof does not reuse a pure-family restriction as though it covered all paths.
Each pure family embeds injectively into the extended family through its reversible display encoding and subtype inclusion. The two images may share the empty word; no joint disjointness is claimed.

The two injections preserve partial maps including domains, and both empty words map to the extended empty word at the same fixed position. The omitted fixed-position subscript is uniquely restored by the quantified u in both languages.

The checked chain combines separate display injectivity, subtype embedding injectivity, exact action/domain preservation and the empty-constructor equations. It proves each required equality without conflating the source and transport families.

Mixed means positive source count and positive transport count, equivalently support meeting both kind subsets. Closed adds equality of the endpoint positions, not an identity-action condition. The two pure families intersect only at the empty word, which is excluded from the mixed family.

The indexed cut retains 0 <= a < b <= length, the original boundary positions, and a source-only closed middle segment. Erasure preserves prefix/suffix order, admissibility and endpoints and reduces length by b-a. IndexedDelete and SegmentDelete are equivalent in both directions; the native path bridge reconstructs every valid displayed cut without adding a loop-identity hypothesis.

Irreducibility excludes every valid indexed source-loop deletion, not only deletions whose successor is mixed. The mixed and closed conditions constrain the original word. The native/display correspondence preserves the full successor relation, including boundary cuts and empty prefixes or suffixes.

The four alternatives are empty, nonempty pure transport, nonempty pure source, and mixed. Fin 4 and the HOL bound c < 4 encode the same exhaustive exclusive cases. Positive source count excludes the empty intersection of the pure images; reversible displays recover the required pure preimages.

The actual case split uses the two kind counts and the empty-word characterization. Separate pure-family display bijections provide the preimages. No action or closed-loop premise is introduced into this syntactic classification.

Deleting a nonempty closed source-only segment gives inclusion of the original action domain in the new domain and agreement on the original domain. It does not claim equality of the two domains. Identity of the removed segment follows from recovery preservation, without a transport-loop identity assumption.

The dependency chain factors the original word into prefix, deleted segment and suffix, uses the derived source-loop identity on the actual intermediate value, and composes the remaining actions. The indexed/native deletion equivalence transfers both domain inclusion and old-domain value equality.

Strict decrease of word length yields a finite trace, with zero steps allowed. Every index from 0 through N retains typed endpoints and extends the original action on its original domain. Transport count is invariant, so the terminal irreducible word is either mixed or a nonempty pure-transport image, rather than empty or pure source.

Well-founded finite reduction constructs the indexed deletion trace with f(0)=p, f(N)=q and one deletion at every n<N. The native trace theorem carries domain inclusion and exact old-domain agreement at every n<=N, not just at the terminal word. Values of the natural-indexed trace beyond N have no role in the source claim.

native_spec_fields retains the exact base, signed path and specified domain, while the candidate action uses only that path. native_spec_positive preserves the source positive-length restriction inside the more general native Spec type. The candidate is formed before L3; no specified-domain realizability is assumed.

HOL extensionality outside declared domains is representation bookkeeping, not an extra physical premise or a restriction of the actual trajectory domain.
The fixed base datum and its transported family retain the same law specification; a differential atlas is additional data, not a consequence of law operability.

The structure retains a nonempty selected law family, positive finite orders, nonnegative side dimensions, actual chart domains, joint coverage and arbitrary local jet relations.

Unindexed differential data refer to the declared fixed evaluation and base representation, without suppressing a changing carrier.

The local numeric domain is the image of the joint time-and-value domain, and the represented trajectory evaluates the actual generated law values through the inverse chart.

CoreLocalCharts defines JointDomain, timeCoord and curve, proving inverse_agrees_with_time_chart. CoreLawComponentCharts.native_side_curve identifies both projections with the generated input/output values; HOL uses the restricted inv_into on the same joint domain.

Each joint-domain time coordinate is bijective onto its numeric image, and each law evaluation has one joint chart witness recovering both value sides.

Restriction of a chart bijection and the supplied simultaneous coverage prove every clause of the local-generation statement.

Predicate extension is false outside the appropriate typed domain; the third, fourth and fifth conditions retain their respective jet or atlas prerequisites.

CoreDynamicsInterfaces proves bounded extension on and outside its domain. Regularity includes open overlaps, smooth actual chart changes and unique lifts acting on every admissible local curve jet.

CoreNativeAtlasConditions.Regular binds ValueChange and TimeChange to actual_chart_change. CoreValueJetChanges and CoreTimeJetChanges prove uniqueness from arbitrary finite polynomial jet realization. HOL Native_Atlas_Certificates and generic value-jet roots supply the same all-germ action.

CoreNativeDifferentialPredicates.totalCurve equals the generated curve on-domain; diff2_iff_smooth_realizations proves equivalence with side realizations. CoreNativeJointJets derives the joint zeroth value and all-order germ independence; HOL proves the same canonical_pair equality.

The zero extension outside the numeric domain cannot affect derivatives at its interior points. The product coordinates are losslessly flattened by a continuous linear equivalence, including zero-dimensional sides.

Generated-jet membership is strictly separated from the all-overlap-jet membership biconditionals introduced in Diff4 and Diff5.
Under the stated conditions the local lifts are unique, preserve the indicated coordinates, obey identity/composition on common overlaps, and act on generated relation members.

CoreValueJetChanges lift_unique, lift_identity and lift_composition realize each arbitrary jet by a finite polynomial; CoreTimeJetChanges proves the analogous time lifts with reversed curve precomposition. The membership bridge applies Diff3 to the actual generated jet.
The source triple-overlap restrictions remain necessary. Time changes preserve the zeroth value, whereas value changes preserve the time coordinate; the two invariances are not interchanged.
The local proof uses arbitrary finite jets, local polynomial realizations and germ invariance, not a finite collection of sampled trajectories.

CoreFiniteJets realizes all derivative slots for arbitrary k. HOL Core_Finite_Jets_Vector proves the finite Taylor realization, and Polynomial_Value_Composition derives the required local composition regularity without adding a curve-preservation assumption. Generic_Value_Jet_Lifts supplies the public all-vector-space roots; finite/trivial atlas roots separately cover the source finite-dimensional range. No extra convergence or analyticity premise is imposed on the original curve.
A bijection of ambient carriers and membership equivalence on the full source carrier give equality of the restricted relation image.

CoreValueJetChanges.relation_image proves each inclusion, using surjectivity to obtain a preimage for every target member. HOL Value_Jet_Lift_Algebra.relation_image uses the same onto-and-membership argument.
Both relations must be subsets of their designated carriers. Membership agreement only on generated trajectories would not suffice for this lemma.
The forward inclusion uses source membership and the biconditional; the reverse inclusion uses an ambient preimage and the reverse implication.
Lean and HOL relation_image proofs explicitly recover the source witness from target membership and ambient surjectivity, then place it in the source relation.
Injectivity is stronger than this set-image argument needs, but it is provided by the source bijection. No missing global-domain assumption is silently introduced.

CoreNativeAtlasConditions.Diff4 packages a regular certificate and ValueCov. value_cov_independent_of_certificate uses polynomial realization and equality of the actual chart changes; diff4_restricts recovers the predicate for any regular certificate. HOL proves the same equivalence.
The relation is restricted by the overlap ambient space, not by the trajectory image. The condition is false outside Diff1 and does not add generated-jet membership as a premise.
Value-chart covariance identifies the exact images of the two overlap-restricted jet relations.

CoreDifferentialCovariance.ValueChange.map_bijective and CoreNativeChartOverlaps.bound_value_relation_image establish the ambient map, then CoreNativeAtlasConditions.value_relation_restriction_image applies the restriction lemma. HOL generic and finite/trivial roots retain the same domains.
The statement concerns relation equality, not just preservation of existing solutions. The time coordinate is unchanged, and arbitrary permitted finite dimension, including zero, is covered.
Bijectivity of the lift plus the all-jet covariance condition proves both restricted-image inclusions.

The lift inverse follows from forward/backward chart identities acting on local realizations. The native atlas proof embeds overlap jets in each full local ambient carrier before applying relation_image; HOL restriction_image_from_bijection performs the same intersection calculation.
No assumption of global overlap equality is used; the source and target overlap domains can differ and are linked by the actual chart transformation.
Diff5 compares two representations of the same generated order structure using shared law indices, orders and value charts, while permitting different time charts.

CoreNativeTimeConditions.RepDomain and RepChange use the actual between-representation equivalence. bound_time_maps_unique and rep_cov_independent_of_certificate use equality on open chart domains; Native_Family_Fibre_Conditions.time_fibre_exact preserves the distinct index fibres.
Both representation atlases satisfy Diff1. Smoothness and lift existence are explicit conditions on chart changes; strict order isomorphism alone does not supply differentiability.
Two admitted embeddings determine the unique strict order isomorphism on their images; with Diff5, that same change yields equality of restricted time-jet relations.

CoreRepresentationImages.image_order_iso_exists_unique fixes the image change by commutation. CoreTimeJetChanges.time_jet_full_domain_bijective and CoreNativeTimeConditions.rep_relation_restriction_image derive the second conclusion on the chart-induced overlaps; HOL separates these same roots.
The order-isomorphism conclusion does not need the smoothness hypothesis, while relation covariance does. Uniqueness is on the actual images, not on arbitrary off-image real extensions.
The proof first fixes the image isomorphism and then applies the overlap relation-transport lemma to its chart realization.

CoreRepresentationImages uses inverse coordinates and order preservation; Core_Chart_Overlaps proves chart_commutes for the actual between-image map. The time certificate is bijective on the full overlap jet carrier and rep_cov supplies the exact membership equivalence.
The curve is precomposed with the inverse time change. This orientation and the restriction to corresponding overlap domains agree in the Japanese source, English source, Lean and HOL.
The graph has five condition nodes and exactly the four stated directed edges; its vertices are conditions, not their Boolean truth values.

The truth-value-image self-loop control separates evaluation dependency from logical implication. In particular Diff2 does not require Diff1 as a truth premise.
The differential datum retains the fixed base representation, its actual law datum and the representation-indexed differential family.

CoreNativeSelectedDifferential.Selected binds its Family to the selected law and subdomain. CoreGeneratedLawIdentity fixes the transported family from that same base law; HOL Native_Differential_Law_Binding proves actual_component_is_core_component.
Neither system substitutes an independently chosen law relation. Shared value indices and law orders coexist with representation-dependent time chart fibres.
Completion is the conjunction of all five universally quantified conditions; differential operability additionally retains operability of the same law datum.

DifferentialNativeDomains.complete uses the correct unary and binary quantifiers. CoreNativeSelectedDifferential requires_same_law and CoreStageBoundaries.diff_requires_law preserve the selected-law link; HOL family_failure_input and selected_differential_input impose the same guard.
One tested chart or one pair of representations is not substituted for the universal family. The law-operability conjunct is not inferred from the five differential conditions alone.
The chart-compatible family and its value-change maps are defined under differential completion, with the time chart index fixed during a value change.

CoreNativeDifferentialSynthesis obtains regular certificates for each selected component and the native relation family. Native_Family_Value_Images derives the complete restricted value-relation image, including finite and zero-dimensional side models.
This definition does not acquire law operability as an additional premise. Value and time transformations have different index scopes and are retained separately.
The generated image-order isomorphism does not by itself supply the analytic value- or time-jet covariance conditions.

The proof traces the order statement to the canonical generated image and traces each differential equality to its corresponding extra condition.

CoreRepresentationImages constructs the unique commuting image isomorphism without smoothness. Native atlas and time certificates subsequently bind the actual chart changes and establish the all-overlap-jet membership equivalences.
Strict order preservation is never used as a substitute for differentiability. Both language versions maintain the separation of the three conclusions.
For the same operative differential datum, every admitted representation pair has the unique commuting image-order isomorphism and the stated full restricted value/time relation equalities.

Uniqueness is on the actual representation images. Equality is for entire overlap-restricted relations, not merely the generated solutions or one selected representative pair.

Certificate choices do not alter the resulting maps: uniqueness on all realizable jets and certificate-independence lemmas remove this auxiliary choice.

The proof does not add edges between otherwise unrelated conditions or assume that every graph edge is a logical implication.

The source update explicitly conditions the relevant conclusion on dynamic operability, consistently in Japanese and English. It does not permit a different law choice for each representation.
The cumulative equivalences are exact comparison plus eight dynamics conditions, then five law conditions, then five differential conditions, with the specified existence and uniqueness conclusions.

CoreThreeLayerSynthesis and Core_Three_Layer_Synthesis combine the stage-boundary equivalences with dynamic-description and witness uniqueness, generated-law core uniqueness, nonempty representation membership and the full differential synthesis.
Uniqueness applies to the generated objects identified in the source, not to arbitrary atlases or selected relation data. All members of the generated representation family are covered.

CoreStageBoundaries supplies the guarded implications, CoreDynamicMaster the dynamic bundle, and CoreGeneratedLawIdentity the common-law family identity. CoreThreeLayerSynthesis then applies the native differential theorem without replacing any upstream datum.
A failure at one stage is not recast as an internal failure of a stage whose input is still unformed. Both languages retain the cumulative, conditional nature of the result.
The joint setting fixes a finite family of at least two object roles with one configuration and observer, while retaining each object-specific evaluation and equivalence.

CoreCarrierPatterns retains role-indexed carriers and assembly; CoreJointInputData carries dependent object data and a shared context. CoreJointDescent uses the componentwise product kernel, not an equality of the individual object carriers.
Shared physical carriers do not merge distinct role indices. The common configuration is fixed without erasing object-specific token types or observer-record data.
Each relation index has its own typed source domain, value carrier and relation, with a nonempty relation-index family; totality and nonempty values are not assumed.
CoreJointInputData.SourceData and JointData retain the dependent domains and typed relations. The Lean and HOL predicate, empty-relation and empty-value controls preserve the admitted boundary cases.
Predicate-valued relations use a one-element value carrier. Nonempty relation indices do not imply that every relation, value carrier or source domain is nonempty.
Saturation requires both domain membership and every value-specific relation membership to be invariant under the given kernel; quotient data are their direct images.

For an onto quotient map with exact kernel and saturated data, both membership biconditionals and uniqueness of the quotient-domain/relation pair hold.

The theorem includes domain saturation, not just relation saturation. Onto-ness is essential to uniqueness on the full target, as the missing-onto control records.
Direct image witnesses and exact-kernel saturation give both biconditionals; surjectivity then determines every target-domain and target-relation membership.

Lean CoreJointDescent uses kernel equality to transfer an image witness to the chosen source representative. HOL Core_Joint_Descent_Alignment proves both inclusions and quotient-pair uniqueness on the designated carriers.
Off-carrier values are excluded in the HOL encoding rather than silently universally quantified as admissible data. No representative choice changes the quotient result.
Every selected joint relation is saturated under the componentwise equivalence of its object-token family, including invariance of its source domain.

The joint projection applies each state quotient projection componentwise and is onto the product of the individual quotient carriers.

CoreJointDescent.prodPrj_surjective chooses component representatives, and prodPrj_kernel proves exact equality with the componentwise equivalence. HOL product_projection_surjective and product_projection_kernel provide the PiE version.
No nonempty source carrier is added. Dependent function and extensional set-function encodings preserve the selected object indices, including empty-product boundary cases.
For every relation type, saturation yields both domain and relation representative criteria and a unique quotient pair.

CoreJointDescent.native_joint_descent instantiates the exact-kernel, onto relation module; Core_Joint_Descent_Alignment supplies the matching typed-carrier theorem. Both preserve the value coordinate in the relation image.
This descent result does not assume common time, trajectory factorization, linearization or real representability. Those conditions enter only subsequent constructions.
The proof obtains the two representative criteria and uniqueness from product-projection surjectivity, its exact kernel and relation saturation.
Lean prodPrj_surjective and prodPrj_kernel feed the generic quotient-pair uniqueness theorem. HOL native_joint_descent follows the same sequence on explicit product and quotient carriers.
The representative choices witness surjectivity only; none becomes an additional parameter of the uniquely determined quotient relation.
The named quotient-level joint relation is the relation component of the unique quotient pair for the same relation index.
CoreJointDescent defines relImage separately from the quotient domain and proves uniqueness of their pair. HOL Core_Joint_Descent_Alignment retains the same index-specific value carrier.
The notation does not merge all relation types into a single relation or suppress their different domains and value carriers.
Equality of the time equivalence and source order gives common canonical quotients, projections and preorders; only the later linear stage requires antisymmetry and incomparability transitivity.

CoreJointTimeSeed proves time_setoids_equal, time_quotient_types_equal, projection agreement and time_order_agrees without the later order hypotheses. CoreJointTime and its HOL counterpart then identify the order-time quotients and embeddings.
Individual state quotients and trajectory domains remain distinct. Equality of common time does not impose equality of those object-specific structures.
The proof first identifies the seed equivalence, generated edges and closure, and only then invokes the stronger order-time construction.

CoreJointTimeSeed.time_order_forward uses the least generated preorder and reverses it through the inverse time map. HOL generated_order_equal unfolds equal equivalence and source-order inputs; the later CoreJointTime roots handle linearization.
The early conclusion is not proved by a locale that already assumes antisymmetry. Canonical identification maps express equality of quotient presentations without arbitrary synchronization data.
The joint trajectory is the tuple of all individual trajectories on precisely the intersection of their common-time domains.

CoreJointTime.Family retains each object datum and factorization conditions. CommonDomain, jointCurve and native_joint_components identify the domain and every component; HOL native_joint_curves proves the corresponding PiE map and uniqueness.
The intersection may be empty. The abbreviated TrjDom and TrjMap are the previously declared dynamic maps, not newly supplied total functions.
The joint trajectory relation is the pullback of the quotient relation along the joint curve, with its original value carrier.
CoreNativeJointRelation.jointRelation and HOL joint_relation/relation_pullback have the displayed membership definition. The source projection uses each actual generated object-state equivalence.
A relation is not assumed single-valued. A singleton value carrier gives the stated predicate case without changing the joint-domain restriction.
Under the four source assumption groups, the three generated objects are unique, each joint state has a source representative, and every such representative satisfies the same relation test.

CoreJointDescent supplies quotient-pair uniqueness, CoreJointTime joint-map uniqueness, and CoreNativeJointRelation trajectory_has_source_representative, every_trajectory_representative_agrees and joint_relation_unique. HOL proves each matching clause.
Existence of a representative and universal agreement of all representatives are both retained. The source does not claim that the representative itself is unique.
Unique individual curves determine the product map; unique quotient data determine the pullback; surjectivity and the descent criterion give the final biconditional.

CoreNativeJointRelation.joint_source_membership rewrites by the supplied sourceProjection equality and applies native_source_descent. Its all-representatives theorem combines that universal implication with the separate existential witness.
The proof neither assumes all trajectory domains coincide nor replaces the universal representative statement by one chosen representative.
One admitted common embedding maps the intersection domain to the real joint domain and maps the relation while leaving values unchanged.

CoreJointRealImage.domain_image, relation_image and ambient_relation_image identify the subtype construction with the exact displayed real set images. HOL proves the ambient image directly using the restricted inverse.
The selected embedding is not unique, and the image need not be all real numbers or nonempty. The joint law-time domain is exactly this same image.
Each observation domain consists of times with some value in its joint relation; the supplied curve selects an allowed value at every such time.

CoreJointLawEvaluation.RelationDomain and Observation store the existential domain and belongs field. HOL relation_domain is Domain of the real relation, and observation_valid imposes membership for every relation index and domain time.

The observation family is supplied input, not a canonical physical observation derived by choice. The locally omitted observer/relation/object-family subscripts are uniquely recoverable as explicitly declared.

The candidate family retains tagged individual observables, relation-specific observations, both side products, restricted evaluation times, all component data and the same joint evaluation specification.

CoreJointLawEvaluation.Selection, SideSpace, sideValue, ComponentInput and FamilyInput preserve the full data. HOL side_value_typed and joint_family_typed establish the corresponding typed carriers and full tuple restrictions; CoreLawDatumAssembly supplies the joint-tagged datum.
Nonempty law indices do not require nonempty selected subsets. Input/output order is preserved, and typing alone does not assert candidate membership or any law condition.
The constructed joint datum has the general law-evaluation type, so its ordered five-condition vector is defined.

CoreJointLawEvaluation.five_condition_connection instantiates CoreLawConditionGraph.condition_vector_exact on the actual joint family. HOL joint_family_typed verifies the carrier premises before the same five-condition connection.
This is a typing and instantiation result, not satisfaction of the five conditions. The stronger common_valid_joint_tuples theorem is not substituted for it.

Lean dependent input/output carriers and candidateTyped enforce the component restrictions. HOL selection_valid, side_value_typed and joint_family_typed prove the explicit carrier facts, including extensionality of the typed faithful-map predicate.

The five routes retain distinct descent, common-time/individual-generation, record-separation, law and same-base differential responsibilities.

CoreJointConditionRoutes and its HOL counterpart connect the actual joint data to descent, embedding transfer, individual curves, approximation conditions 3 and 5, law failure and matching differential failure. CoreContinuumDatum.width_failure and actual_failure retain readiness and exact packet matching.

Failure is not inferred from a missing input domain. The differential route requires the same operative law; record defects exceed their own tolerances, and zero-based formal indices are matched to the paper indices.
The final chapter synthesis retains all three same-input operativity equivalences and their conditional outputs, then separately builds the joint-time, relation and law structures.

CoreThreeLayerSynthesis, CoreNativeLawGeneration and CoreNativeDifferentialSynthesis provide the individual outputs. CoreJointTimeSeed, CoreJointTime, CoreNativeJointRelation and CoreJointLawEvaluation provide the joint outputs under their stated additional assumptions.

The bilingual update from evidence datum to witness object matches the actual generated object. The local abbreviation is recoverable only for one fixed evaluation, and the adopted figure adds no independent logical premise.
The six-series audit retains the complete evaluation input, selected evidence, scale-dependent approximation branch and recoverable local abbreviations.

CoreAuditData.Input and Evidence retain configuration and evaluation, while CoreLocalizationBundle assembles the six-series signature and boundary data. CoreRawLocalizationInterfaces valid_membership, section_membership and family_intersection unfold those constructions in Lean and HOL. empty_family gives the entire typed carrier for an empty selected family.
